lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region. Centroids are organized into at least five observable vertical columns, with spatial distribution following a roughly equidistant matrix between the horizontal carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal carinae to form a coordinate-like grid, with the high-luminance blobs positioned at the approximate center of these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance on the dorsal aspect, shadow on the ventral aspect) consistent with structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, with a notable concentration of smaller clusters toward the distal tip and trailing edge.
